description: Save the current state of the project as a checkpoint on the user's Plyo timeline. Call this after completing a piece of work.

intent.description: One sentence summarizing what the user actually asked for, in their own words, e.g. 'Make the pricing page feel more premium and add a yearly toggle'. Always pass this — it becomes the project's memory of why changes were made.

note.description: One plain-English sentence describing what changed, written for a non-technical user, e.g. 'Added a pricing page with three plans'

name: save_checkpoint
